SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch S.2.
Date November 22, 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S. B. REGI / No. D / Date 22/11/33）

Subject (in full) Arrival of I. Odign alias Odin, Soviet employee.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名] 8-2.

Indrik Odign alias Odin, 40, Soviet citizen of Latvian
nationality, reported to be an employee of the United Petroleum
Trust of U.S.S.R. (Soyouzneft), arrived in Shanghai from the
U.S.S.R. via Japan on November 20, 1933, in the s.s. President
Coolidge. He holds passport No. 87834 issued on September 21,
1933 at Moscow which bears a visa issued by the Chinese Legation
in that city on September 29, 1933.
Odign was accompanied by his wife, Mrs K.M. Odign.
Upon arrival here they stayed at the Plaza Hotel for one day
after which they removed to an address which has not yet been
located.

（批：JR）

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch. [签名]
